result.summary: Adds an `auto_outbound_mode` feature to the functional test framework and introduces a new functional test `p2p_outbound_management.py`. In this mode, the node under test opens outbound connections to addresses in addrman via a local SOCKS5 proxy that redirects them to controllable Python P2P peers or other test nodes. The PR also refactors `p2p_private_broadcast.py` to use the shared framework implementation instead of its own duplicate proxy redirection logic.
result.problem: P2P connection management logic where the node autonomously decides when to open and evict outbound connections lacks functional test coverage because functional tests usually rely on inbound connections or test-runner-initiated outbound connections (`add_outbound_p2p_connection`). Substantive features like opening extra outbound connections on stale tips, periodic block-relay-only feeler rotations, and network diversification across reachability types have had no end-to-end functional test coverage.
evidence: Adds automated test coverage for several long-standing outbound connection features: extra full outbound connections due to a stale tip (#11560), periodic block-relay-only connections (#19858), and full outbound connection management with respect to networks (#27213) (PR description).

Extracts and shares generalizable SOCKS5 redirection test infrastructure originally introduced in #29415, removing 101 lines of duplicate test code from `p2p_private_broadcast.py` (commit d8b30ad131).
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased to adapt to recent dynamic port allocation changes in proxy test utilities; the overall scope and test logic remain unchanged.
result.card: Adds an auto_outbound_mode harness to the functional test framework and introduces functional test coverage for outbound connection management. Functional tests typically rely on the test runner manually initiating connections, leaving the node's autonomous outbound connection decisions untested end-to-end. By redirecting addrman-driven outbound connections through a local SOCKS5 proxy back to controllable Python P2P peers, this test verifies stale-tip extra connection logic, periodic block-relay-only connections, and network diversification across networks. It also removes duplicate proxy redirection code from p2p_private_broadcast.py.

risk.why: Only touches Python functional tests and test framework infrastructure without modifying node production code.
